---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Extract the county tab-separated files to a temporary directory and read them in
pct_files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

gov_rep_totals <- read_tsv(
  pct_files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  col_select = c(office = X12, candidate = X15, party = X16, votes = X19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)
```

```{r}
gov_rep_totals |>
  mutate(candidate = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_votes, y = candidate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#b22222") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official precinct-level vote totals across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
